records.title: Republic of Indonesia — Second Nationally Determined Contribution (Second NDC), 2025
records.summary: The UNFCCC registry records the Republic of Indonesia Second NDC as submitted on 27 October 2025. Its scope covers national mitigation commitments, including energy, and references net-zero emissions by 2060 or earlier. This NDC is separate from Indonesia's 2016 deposit of ratification.
records.limitation: Registration does not itself prove a particular project's emissions limit, a sector's compliance or achievement of a target.

records.title: Peraturan Pemerintah Nomor 40 Tahun 2025 tentang Kebijakan Energi Nasional
records.summary: Government Regulation 40/2025 was promulgated on 15 September 2025; the issuing ministry's official register shows it as berlaku and records that it repeals PP 79/2014. It sets Indonesia's national energy policy framework, balancing security, affordability and a transition toward cleaner energy. This is domestic policy context, not wording inside the 2016 treaty-ratification statute.
records.limitation: The legal status shown is the registry status at source review; later amendments and clause-specific obligations require updated JDIH and actual legal text verification.

records.title: Peraturan Presiden Nomor 110 Tahun 2025 tentang Penyelenggaraan Instrumen Nilai Ekonomi Karbon dan Pengendalian Emisi Gas Rumah Kaca Nasional
records.summary: Presidential Regulation 110/2025 was promulgated on 10 October 2025. The official legislative register identifies this as carbon-economic instruments and greenhouse-gas emissions governance, including NDC arrangements, and states that it revokes Perpres 98/2021. This is a later Indonesian implementation-related policy instrument, not an automatic direct obligation created by Articles 1–2 of UU 16/2016.
records.limitation: Clause-specific mechanisms, participant obligations and future legal status must be assessed from current official consolidated text and its implementing rules.
